# Untitled work and replacement data

The work-before-Create cases follow the owner's UI contract. The short name
`lbco_hrpt-7` names the selected project folder. Title, Authors and Description
are shown in the report (`core/src/report_model.cpp`, `core/src/report_html.cpp`);
the CIF exporter does not consume these project metadata fields. Placeholder
checks require that purpose, without prescribing the rest of the wording.

`inputs.py` reuses the independent P1 fit-policy declarations. Replacement
observations are literal input values, not calculated output. Their changed
abscissas require a new calculated grid. The expected measured rows and the
fresh-calculation invariant are independent of a previous cached curve.

Chart replacement uses the real Experiments row menu and chooser. Drawn runs
use the existing app capture platform so Qt Graphs renders its actual series.
Linux llvmpipe is a regression diagnostic; the original macOS crash still needs
the macOS runner to qualify its native backend.
